(second callout, same as S-02). The slashed-rectangle symbol is read as a rectangular hollow section, designation RHS.

Support chains and panel ticks are in the grid master (dimension_chains, S-04) and became x dummies per section 4 rule 4. The eave overhang of the top chord is drawn but its length is not printed on this sheet (S-03 prints 1.00 to the roof edge).

Each elevation tags the crossing truss at its apex/panel post: T1 carries 'T3' at the apex (correct — T3 runs along x = 3.25). T5 and T2 both carry 'T5' at x = 5.00, where the S-03 plan and the S-05 T4 elevation (ends tagged T2 / T5) put Truss T4 — read as a labelling slip for T4, kept as printed in note.
